digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and LLM token management
propositions: Plan-review dominates LLM spend at 71% re-runs and ~26.5 LLM calls per review; token usage must be cut without weakening gate outcomes.
Evidence-backed optimization program includes reuse paths, pre-LLM short-circuits, cache efficiency, criterion gating/calibration, and instrumentation, all validated against sidecar corpus backtests.
Pass-1 per-call usage accounting instrumentation must measure token totals (input/output/cache) and enable subsequent cache optimizations to be measured.
Blocking criteria (T3, T10, T5c HIGH, G7 contradicts_reality) must use operator-approved thresholds while preserving blocking status of all previously blocking criteria.
All 18 child changes (17 planned plus 1 regression fix) must land through Gerrit with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before epic closure.
